# FINXIA Capital

> FINXIA Capital is an AI-native alternative asset management vehicle (Luxembourg SCSp) that deploys capital across real assets enhanced by artificial intelligence infrastructure.

## Core Strategies

- [TITAN DC AI](/strategies/): Brown-to-green transformation of underutilized European datacenter campuses. Partner: THERMIS B.V. (TÜV Rheinland certified AI optimization platform). Geographic focus: Europe-wide (France, Spain, Italy primary markets). ESG Green Bond / SFDR Article 9.
- [Premium Hospitality](/strategies/): 4-5 star European hotels with operational repositioning
- [Urban Residential Flex](/strategies/): Coliving, build-to-rent, PBSA across major European cities
- [C.CAPITAL](/strategies/): Ultra-selective late-stage, secondaries and special situations

## About

- [About FINXIA Capital](/about/): AI-native architecture with 18 AI agents. Alternative assets + AI infrastructure thesis.
- [European Approach](/european-approach/): EED Art.12, NIS2, GRESB, EU AI Act regulatory framework
- [Blog](/blog/): Expert analysis on European datacenter energy, AI-native fund management
